entries.name: Jamal Joseph

expected.convicted: No; youth case separated and the prosecution did not produce a conviction
expected.sentence: Held at Rikers Island until supporters posted bail in March 1970; the exact release day has not been established.

updates.sentence: Held after the April 2, 1969 Panther 21 arrest until release on bail in February 1970, as recalled in his memoir. The exact release day is not established; later custody is separate.

entries.rationale: First-person memoir explicitly says release occurred February 1970, contradicting March in current sentence and derivative group summaries. Existing release precision already month; populate month without inventing day. His later 1982-1987 case remains untouched.
